**Operator action:** re-extract the upload with a reader that resolves embedded-font encodings and preserves word spacing (or OCR the page images), then re-upload; the extraction is otherwise complete-looking (122 pages, and its table of contents decodes to Parts I–III, Chapters 1–10, Conclusion, Appendices A–C, References), so only the text layer needs fixing.
